mechanism_narrative: An increase in the federal funds rate by more than 0.5% within a month signals a tightening monetary policy, leading to increased borrowing costs and reduced corporate earnings, which results in negative S&P 500 forward returns over the next 20 trading days.
failure_condition: If the 20-day forward returns are positive in more than 40% of the instances where FEDFUNDS increased by more than 0.5% within a month.

mechanism_narrative: A sharp increase in the unemployment rate by more than 0.5% within two months indicates a weakening labor market, which is a leading indicator of economic slowdown and negative S&P 500 forward returns over the next 60 trading days.
failure_condition: If the 60-day forward returns are positive in more than 60% of the instances where UNRATE increased by more than 0.5% within two months.

mechanism_narrative: A sustained decline in real GDP growth for two consecutive quarters signals a weakening demand environment, leading to negative S&P 500 forward returns over the next 60 trading days.
failure_condition: If the 60-day forward returns are positive in more than 50% of the instances where GDPC1 shows a sustained decline over two consecutive quarters.

mechanism_narrative: An increase in industrial production by more than 1% within a month signals a strengthening supply side, which is a positive indicator for economic growth and S&P 500 forward returns over the next 20 trading days.
failure_condition: If the 20-day forward returns are negative in more than 40% of the instances where INDPRO increased by more than 1% within a month.

mechanism_narrative: A simultaneous increase in housing starts and a decrease in retail sales signals a shift in consumer spending from goods to housing, which may indicate a temporary economic slowdown and negative S&P 500 forward returns over the next 5 trading days.
candidate_trigger: HOUST increase > 5% in 1 month and RSAFS decrease > 1% in 1 month
failure_condition: If the 5-day forward returns are positive in more than 60% of the instances where HOUST increased by more than 5% and RSAFS decreased by more than 1% within a month.

mechanism_narrative: A decrease in nonfarm payrolls by more than 100,000 within a month signals a weakening labor market, which is a negative indicator for economic growth and S&P 500 forward returns over the next 20 trading days.
failure_condition: If the 20-day forward returns are positive in more than 50% of the instances where PAYEMS decreased by more than 100,000 within a month.

mechanism_narrative: A sustained increase in the Consumer Price Index (CPI) for three consecutive months signals inflationary pressure, which may lead to monetary tightening and negative S&P 500 forward returns over the next 60 trading days.
failure_condition: If the 60-day forward returns are positive in more than 50% of the instances where CPIAUCSL shows a sustained increase over three consecutive months.

mechanism_narrative: A simultaneous increase in retail sales and a decrease in the unemployment rate signals a strengthening consumer demand environment, which is a positive indicator for economic growth and S&P 500 forward returns over the next 20 trading days.
candidate_trigger: RSAFS increase > 1% in 1 month and UNRATE decrease > 0.3% in 1 month
failure_condition: If the 20-day forward returns are negative in more than 40% of the instances where RSAFS increased by more than 1% and UNRATE decreased by more than 0.3% within a month.
